title: Tales Of Big Foot
description: This mod adds Big Foot (Big Surprise!).
body:
This mod was made with...
![Text that says "M Creator".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f11d8dfdf76887a1984108985f7c39507e25cb15.webp)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This mod was made as a joke, but adds a few new features including:
1. Big Foot Mob
  ![An ape like creature named "Big Foot"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8fbf5f29db94b2b9133524bee241ad80f83c0eab_0.webp)
2. Redwood Forest Biome
   ![A forest, containing trees with red logs, dubbed a "Redwood Forest".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca4a20ce40ef2d357012e12c13048d6e14efcabf_0.webp)
3. Big Foot Slayer Weapon
   ![A sword that is red, called the "Big Foot Slayer".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e940cfa21a985a907dabcde02ab96d99899f45e_0.webp)
4. A slightly cheaper Spyglass recipe (To help you spot Big Foot)
   ![A crafting recipe for a spyglass.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1781257f60c640548d686ca3250d0dfeaea228d1.png)
5. A Big Foot Item
   ![A literal big foot.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2fca947c9a7300b3da91ae7d7164f9ba697ee573_0.webp)
6. An Abomination Item.
   ![An item of undescribable appearance.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b2b5b81489435b9f485e526aca26a29fe67ca52_0.webp)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Enjoy!
